content: The uterus is of average size and shape with homogenous myometrium and central endometrium. Left antero lateral pre uterine oval shape lesion is seen measuring about 5.2x7.6 cm with fat signal on all pulse sequences with eccentric non enhanced tissue of iso intense signal on T1 and low signal on T2 without enhancement. The ovaries could not be clearly idnetified. Average distension of the urinary bladder with no masses, diverticula or significant wall thickening. No enlarged lymph nodes or pelvic collections. Preserved marrow signal of the imaged bones. Normal MR appearance of the peri articular musculature with preserved intervening fat planes. Conclusion: Left anterolateral pre uterine lesion likely teratoma for tumor markers " What does the above mean?
